article_title: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Uber's immediate withdrawal from Nigeria and Uganda after reviewing difficult market conditions
Uber's plan to introduce boat services in every African capital
A new fuel subsidy for ride-hailing drivers in Nigeria
Uber's acquisition of Bolt, inDrive and SafeBoda
tasks.correct_answer: Uber's immediate withdrawal from Nigeria and Uganda after reviewing difficult market conditions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהחלטת Uber להפסיק מיד את פעילותה בניגריה ובאוגנדה, על רקע תנאי שוק מאתגרים.

tasks.prompt: When did Uber begin operating in Nigeria and Uganda?
options: Nigeria in 2016 and Uganda in 2019
Nigeria in 2014 and Uganda two years later
Both countries in 2023
Nigeria in 2019 and Uganda in 2014
tasks.correct_answer: Nigeria in 2014 and Uganda two years later
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Uber החלה לפעול בניגריה ב־2014 ובאוגנדה שנתיים לאחר מכן.

tasks.prompt: After the two closures, in which African countries does Uber still operate?
options: Nigeria, Uganda, Tanzania and Ivory Coast
Egypt, Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria
Egypt, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa
Ghana, Tanzania, Ivory Coast and South Africa
tasks.correct_answer: Egypt, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר היציאה Uber נשארת פעילה באפריקה במצרים, גאנה, קניה ודרום אפריקה.

tasks.prompt: Why did rising petrol prices create particular pressure on ride-hailing drivers?
options: They made boat travel illegal in Lagos
They removed all competing taxi apps
They increased passenger numbers automatically
They raised operating costs while fares were already considered low
tasks.correct_answer: They raised operating costs while fares were already considered low
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחירי דלק גבוהים מעלים את עלות הנסיעות, בזמן שנהגים כבר טענו שהתעריפים נמוכים והעמלות גבוהות.

tasks.prompt: What does “the void was likely to be filled” mean in the discussion of Kampala?
options: Other taxi apps were expected to take Uber's place in the market
Kampala's roads were expected to become empty
Uber planned to return under another name
All commuters would stop using ride-hailing
tasks.correct_answer: Other taxi apps were expected to take Uber's place in the market
tasks.explanation_hebrew: void הוא פער בשוק; כאן הכוונה שאפליקציות אחרות צפויות להחליף את השירות של Uber.

tasks.prompt: What does “gridlock” mean in the description of Lagos traffic?
options: A system for setting fares
A protest by drivers
Severe traffic congestion with very restricted movement
A mobile-phone network failure
tasks.correct_answer: Severe traffic congestion with very restricted movement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: gridlock הוא עומס תנועה חמור שבו כלי רכב כמעט אינם יכולים להתקדם.

tasks.prompt: Identify the business and economic pressures that made the Nigerian market difficult.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות ארבעה לחצים מדויקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Drivers said fares were too low
Commission charges were considered too high
Fuel and operating costs were rising
Drivers protested over costs, fares and working conditions
Bolt, inDrive and local operators created competition
Removal of the fuel subsidy raised living costs
Petrol prices rose again following the US war with Iran

tasks.prompt: What shows that the withdrawal is significant locally but not a complete exit from Africa?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא ראיות להשפעה המקומית ולצד זאת להמשך פעילות החברה באפריקה.
expected_points: Uber had operated in Nigeria for 12 years
It had expanded into a Lagos boat service
The departure changes commuting in Kampala
Workers and drivers are affected
The decision is limited to two markets
Uber remains in Egypt, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa
Other apps may fill the local gap

tasks.prompt: Summarise Uber's decision, the reasons behind it and the immediate consequences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את שתי המדינות, תנאי השוק, מצב הפעילות באפריקה והסיוע שהובטח.
expected_points: Uber closed in Nigeria and Uganda immediately
The decision followed a business review
Low fares, high commissions, fuel costs and competition created pressure
Uber had already left Ivory Coast and Tanzania
It now operates in four African countries
Other apps may replace it locally
Uber pledged support for affected workers
The help centre remains open until 23 September

tasks.prompt: Write a short notice for affected drivers and passengers explaining the closure and next steps.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית בטון ברור ומכבד, עם לפחות ארבע עובדות וללא הבטחות שאינן בכתבה.
expected_points: State that operations closed immediately in Nigeria and Uganda
Mention the business review and market pressures
Clarify that Uber has not left all of Africa
Name alternative apps mentioned
Mention support for affected employees and drivers
State that the help centre remains open until 23 September
Do not invent compensation arrangements
